payload.description: The dates wanted, both ends included: from alone names one day, from and to a range, to alone every day up to it; neither, every day.

reply.description: Every day written in the range, oldest first; a date with nothing written is not listed.

text.description: What is written on that day.

tool.description: Returns the reader's journal days, oldest first, each with its date and everything written on it. Give from alone (YYYY-MM-DD) for one day, from and to for a range (both included), to alone for every day up to it, or nothing for the whole journal. Days with nothing written are left out. The text is markdown: a line starting with # is a title, ## a heading, ### a subheading. Use it to read what the reader wrote on a given day or over a period; to know which day the journal page shows now, read the open journal day instead.
tool.label: Reading journal days
